The '''Mid-Rim Sentinel Agency''' was a security and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] which operated in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Detien Kaileel]] worked for the agency as a [[Detective/Legends|detective]] for over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before being wounded in the line of duty during an undercover operation targeting a notorious [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
